what: The repacker output tree as it is today, captured before any M2.6 change. Core/Repack/** had zero tests when this was taken.

provenance.note: Captured from the working tree, which is dirty. The head is provenance, not a claim that the measured source equals that commit.
provenance.ffmpeg: ffmpeg version 8.1.2-essentials_build-www.gyan.dev Copyright (c) 2000-2026 the FFmpeg developers

limits: Full emission order is not observable: MenuProcessor reports one item in ten and the CLI verbose printer shows CurrentItem only, never Message. Content hashes are the oracle; they subsume order wherever order changes output, such as which source wins a contested menu path.
Four of the five BSAs (4.1 GB) are not captured. Only Fallout - Misc.bsa is, so BSA coverage is one archive, not the set.
Music hashes are bound to the recorded ffmpeg build.
The INI phase has no CLI toggle, so every run also emits Fallout_default.ini.

menus-nodonor.note: Console menus only. Nine PC-required documents are held back for a donor that is not configured, then written from console bytes as a last resort.

menus-donor.note: Console menus plus PC donor backfill. This is the baseline/donor ordering M2.6 must preserve: console documents win except for the ones the retail executable cannot run.

esp.note: DEFECT REPAIRED 2026-09-12: the retail update.esp now reaches the converted build, copied byte-for-byte because it already ships in PC byte order. EsmProcessor gained the endianness guard EsmConvertCommand always had, and a failed phase now reaches RepackResult.Success and Error instead of being swallowed.

esm.note: Big-endian to little-endian conversion of the 246 MB console master.

bsa-misc.note: Extract, convert and repack, bounded to the smallest of the five archives (1.6 MB) so the whole path is exercised without the 4.1 GB the other four cost.

music.note: XMA to MP3 through ffmpeg. Hashes here are bound to the ffmpeg build recorded below, not to the repacker alone, so a hash change on this phase must rule out a toolchain change first.

supersededPhases.why: This capture recorded the defect as found: the phase emitted no plugin at all, only the INI phase output, and the run reported success. It is retained because the repair is only legible against what it replaced.
supersededPhases.previousNote: DEFECT FROZEN AS FOUND: emits no ESP at all. The retail X360 update.esp is already little-endian (it begins TES4, not 4SET), the endian converter rejects it, EsmProcessor swallows the exception into a progress Message the CLI never prints, and RepackAsync reports Success anyway. The converted build silently has no update.esp.
